title: Reserve Bank of India (Responsible Business Conduct) Amendment Directions, 2026 - Recovery Framework (Nine Simultaneous Circulars)
description: RBI issued nine comprehensive circulars simultaneously on August 6, 2026, consolidating loan recovery and recovery agent engagement rules across all regulated entities (Commercial Banks, Small Finance Banks, Local Area Banks, Regional Rural Banks, Urban Co-operative Banks, Rural Co-operative Banks, All India Financial Institutions, NBFCs, and Housing Finance Companies). The new framework replaces scattered instructions with unified standards effective January 1, 2027, establishing recovery contact windows (8 AM-7 PM), mandatory advance borrower notification, call recording requirements, published empanelled agency lists, prohibition of harsh practices, and compensation obligations for non-compliant recovery conduct.
